summary: Equip yourself with essential knowledge on biodiversity conservation in oil and gas. Our training course offers practical insights for a sustainable future.
lede: Biodiversity conservation in oil and gas operations helps HSE and environmental professionals identify ecological risks across project activities. Participants learn to assess habitats and establish biodiversity baselines, apply the mitigation hierarchy, and plan conservation measures for sites and project stages. The course also covers monitoring and adaptive management, plus reporting biodiversity findings through HSE and ESG processes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who are responsible for balancing operational goals with environmental stewardship in the oil and gas industry.
audience: Oil and gas project managers and compliance
Land access and stakeholder engagement officers
modules: Introduction to Biodiversity in Oil and Gas Context
Environmental Impact Assessment and Baseline Studies
Mitigation Hierarchy in Oil & Gas Operations
Case Studies, Audit Simulation, and Action Planning
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of oil and gas operations and a keen interest in environmental sustainability. Prior experience in HSE or project management is advantageous.
